messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: sev2 - collective timeout observed in tp4 job (job_id=rembrandt-prod-42). All tensors stuck at rendezvous stage, inferred root cause: NCCL TIMEOUT. Sampling logs: `ncclCommAbort` / `NCCL_TIMEOUT`

lina-cheung: oncall, I see spikes in p99 latency and multiple replicas stuck. Noticed a lot of `Xid` CUDA errors in kube logs.

sanjay-kapur: jumping in. Can you paste the tail of the driver logs and the pod status?

mike-carr: pod list: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l job=rembrandt-prod-42` shows 4 pods Running, 2 in CrashLoopBackOff. Node n-gpu-13 shows `NotReady` briefly earlier.

ophelia-ops: logs from pod rembrandt-worker-3: ```
2026-03-17T10:03:12Z ERROR nccl: ncclCommAbort called
2026-03-17T10:03:12Z ERROR cuda: Xid 79 on GPU 2
2026-03-17T10:03:12Z WARN runtime: stale rendezvous, waiting
```

lina-cheung: this looks like a multi-gpu communicator failed mid-epoch. Suspect GPU driver glitch or PCI-e transient. Need to remove node from rotation, fallback to single-gpu variant for in-flight requests.

eng-oncall: ack. I'll start mitigation. Steps: 1) cordon n-gpu-13 2) drain noncritical pods 3) scale rembrandt job to spawn single-gpu fallback image 4) restart driver on node (if reachable) 5) run smoke eval.

sanjay-kapur: while that's happening, add `--nccl-debug=INFO` to new replicas to get more logs. Also enable `runtime.fallback_on_comm_error=true` for quick degrad.

mike-carr: cordon done: `kubectl cordon n-gpu-13` — pod eviction in progress. Draining low-priority pods now.

ophelia-ops: tried SSH to n-gpu-13, host is up but dmesg shows repeated GPU resets. Running `sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced` and `modprobe -r nvidia_uvm && modprobe nvidia_uvm` to clear UVM.

lina-cheung: good; meanwhile, start routing policy change to avoid pipeline parallel placements across nodes with suspected fabric flakiness. Put policy to `prefer-local-gpu` for rembrandt.

incident-bot: Note: Customer-facing API error rate rose to 4.8% between 10:02-10:08 UTC. Affected tenants: acme-inc, beta-studio, synthai (partial failures). Logged to incident ticket INC-2026-847.

sanjay-kapur: confirmed affected requests are mostly long-context pipeline runs. Shorter inferences fall back OK. We should notify SRE and CS for customer outreach.

eng-oncall: scaled fallback pool: `kubectl set image deployment/rembrandt-fallback rembrandt=fallback:v2-nogroup` — new pods passing liveness. Adding `runtime.kv_cache_enabled=false` temporarily to avoid stale KV sync issues.

mike-carr: smoke test: 5/5 sample prompts succeed on fallback, latencies up ~2.1x but throughput maintained. Rolling traffic over using canary for 25% then 100%.

lina-cheung: advise CS: template message drafted, summarizing impact, mitigation, and ETA for full restore (~45m). Please review and send.

ophelia-ops: restarted drivers on n-gpu-13; node ready. However kernel logs still show occasional `NVLINK link flaps`. Keeping node cordoned until we validate stability for two hours or repro steps done.

eng-oncall: handing off to night-shift oncall @sanjay-kapur for extended triage. Current status: primary traffic on fallback single-gpu pool, customer errors reduced to 0.8%, driver restart done but node cordoned. Action items: collect kernel + nvlink logs, test multi-gpu allreduce under stress, prepare hotpatch if reproducible.

sanjay-kapur: taking it. I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem and add regression tests. Leaving timeline note in INC-2026-847.

lina-cheung: thanks team. Final update here once node fully uncordoned or if we need to enact hardware replacement. :thumbsup:
